Dialogs.Dialog: Hey, um... It might just be my imagination, but...
I feel like you haven't been emailing much lately. Are you avoiding me？
...Could we be going through what they call a rut？
Wait, what!? ● doesn't think that at all, though？
Neither do I, you know？ But you barely send any emails lately.
I do. Jeez, what am I gonna do with you.
Hey, um... I feel like the emails have been tapering off...
I'm waiting every day, you know. If you don't write more... I'll pout, okay？
Seems like you're already pouting, though...
You haven't... gotten tired of me, have you？
Of course not!? What brought this on？
Sorry. It's just... I feel like we haven't been kissing as much lately.
...You think so？ Just because we haven't kissed as much doesn't mean I don't love you.
Hey, haven't you been kind of cold lately？
Huh？ I don't really think I have, though...
But you barely ever kiss me these days.
Or is there something about me that's bothering you？
Hey, have you noticed？ What's been missing between us lately.
...Kisses. You barely give me any lately, do you？
Don't make me have to say stuff like this, okay...？
You've broken our date plans a few times now. Why？
It's not like you don't wanna see me anymore... right？
(She's in kind of a bad mood...)
You know, I'm actually a little bit mad.
You stood me up so many times... Did you really think I wouldn't care？
Are you really reflecting on what you did？ Hm？
(I guess she really is a little mad...)
Hey, can we talk for a sec？
Lately, you haven't been keeping your promises. And I always look forward to our dates, too.
I really don't want to have to say this. You get it, right？
(I'd better not make her any madder...)
Hey, could we talk for a minute？
You kinda ignored me on our last date... Did something happen？
...Don't do that again, okay？ It makes me sad.
(Looks like I upset her... Well, can't blame her.)
...You didn't say a word to me, you know.
On our last date. You were quiet the whole time.
Care to explain what that was about？
Yes, something is wrong. Leaving your girlfriend all alone during our date...
You'd better reflect on how that made me feel, okay？
Lately... we haven't seen much of each other, have we？
Doesn't it bother you？ Because I... want to see you more.
Hey, what should I do so you'll see me more often？
(Looks like I've been making her feel lonely...)
How do you feel about us lately？
What do you mean, how do I feel...？
I just feel like we haven't been seeing each other much.
If it were up to me, I'd want to see you more... That's how I feel.
You know... I want to see you more.
Aren't we seeing each other right now, though？
Well, yes, but... we haven't hung out much lately.
It gets lonely like this. I want to see you so much more...
(I really made her feel lonely, huh...)
That girl just now... is she a friend of yours？
Well, just a regular friend. Did that bother you？
Just a little bit. But only a little, really. I'm not worried about it.
(Seems like it kind of bothers her, though...)
You seemed pretty close with that person just now.
You think so？ Just a regular friend.
I see... Maybe I'm just overthinking it？
Who was that girl just now？ You two looked pretty close.
Just a regular friend... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you jealous, by any chance？
It's not like that, but... it's hard not to wonder, you know？
Yeah... Thanks for worrying about me.
Didn't you catch that cold from ●, though？
Hmm... I don't really know. Don't worry about that.
Don't make that face. I'll be fine once I get some good rest.
Maybe so. But really, you don't have to worry about that.
Give that cold back to me
I'm all right... A little rest and I'll be good as new.
Sorry. You caught that cold from ●, right？
Don't apologize. I don't blame you at all.
I want to take responsibility. ● will take that cold back.
Always trying to act cool... Just hearing you say that is enough.
Give that cold back to me. Then you'll feel better, right？
Jeez. There'd be no end to it if we did that, would there？
Pass it to ●, too. Because of ●, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is...
...Rejected. I don't want you suffering. I just need to rest up properly.
I really feel bad about it...
You don't need to apologize... Though, it does make me kind of happy.
Don't worry about it. Instead, once I'm better, you have to hang out with me a whole bunch, okay？
Don't give me that cute face. You're gonna make this older girl's fever go up, you know？
Oh, right, I sliced some apples. Think you can eat？
Does that mean you're gonna feed me？
Sure, no problem. Just get comfortable.
Thanks for coming by to see me today. Thanks to you, I think I'll get better in no time.
Yeah. Well, ● should get going soon. I'll be waiting for you to get all better.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Are you feeling better already？
Completely! Sorry for making you worry.
That's a relief... Though I never did get around to visiting you.
It's okay. At least I didn't pass it to you, right？
(Worrying about ●, too... Maybe I should've gone to visit.)
Since you didn't come visit me, I had to manage all on my own.
Ah... Sorry I couldn't make it over.
Just kidding! Besides, I didn't want you seeing me all weak anyway.
(Still, I bet she would've been happy if I'd visited...)
Is your cold really all better now？
That's good... I was planning to visit, but you beat me to it and got better first.
Aw, that's too bad. I really wanted you to nurse me back to health, too.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you feeling all right now？
You gave me the energy I needed to bounce back.
Kisses really do have some kind of mysterious power, don't they？
That's good... Looks like you're full of energy again.
That's the power of your visit. Were you okay after that, though？
Yeah, no problem at all. Let me know if you ever catch a cold again.
A kiss every time I get sick？ That... might not be so bad, actually.
I'm glad. Looks like you're back on your feet.
I definitely have you to thank for that.
Geez, don't put it so bluntly!
Hey, is talking to me too tiring？ Are you okay？
I'm fine. If anything, you're giving me energy.
Your cold... Can I try taking it from you to see if it cures you？
Feeling any worse？ You've got to stay in bed and rest, you know.
I'm not a kid, you know. I'll stay in bed and behave.
Your cold looks pretty rough. Want me to try taking it home with me？
Get well soon, okay...？ I've been worrying about you the whole time.
Thanks. Don't go catching it yourself, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hey... doesn't kissing pass a cold and cure it？ Want to give it a try？
Yeah... I'll give it a try.
I was only teasing, but... all right, here goes？
We won't know if it's true unless we try, right？
That's what I like to hear. Now then...
...Did that give you some energy back？
Yeah. I feel like I'm getting my strength back.
Good. That must mean your cold passed to me, then.
(Well, it's not like she actually caught it.)
Yeah... I feel a lot better.
Good. If I catch a cold now, you have to take care of me just like this, okay？
(Not that it actually works that way, though.)
...Did I catch your cold, do you think？
You can't catch it! You'll get sick in bed, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
What are you saying？ If I don't catch it, you won't get better.
(It's not like that actually happens, though.)
Get over your cold soon, okay？ Pretty please？
You too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... Make sure you don't catch it.
I know. We can't go on dates unless we're both healthy, after all.
Yeah... thanks. My body feels a lot lighter.
Me too. Did the cold just run off somewhere？
Wait, did you catch my cold!?
No, that's not it... I just got all shy all of a sudden.
That wouldn't be good. Then you'd catch my cold, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I wouldn't mind if I did, though... Okay, I got it.
Come on, that's impossible. Passing it to you won't cure me.
Hmm... Is that how it works？
A superstition, huh... Yeah, I guess so.
How's your stomach？ I made some rice porridge for you, but...
I can eat! Thanks for the food!
Thanks for visiting, I'm already feeling better!
I'm glad. I should probably get going now. Get plenty of rest until you're all better, okay？
You're not pushing yourself？ Are you really all better？
As you can see, I'm fit as a fiddle.
What a relief... I was worried the whole time.
It really wasn't that big of a deal. Thanks for worrying about me.
Welcome back! Are you feeling alright now？
Yeah. It wasn't that bad of a cold to begin with.
I see. If you're that full of energy, I guess I don't need to pamper you then.
I'm glad you're better... I was worried, you know.
To make up for lost time, I'll be sure to spoil you rotten, okay？
My cold's totally gone. It's all thanks to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hehe, guess visiting you was worth it then.
By the way... are you okay？ You didn't catch it or anything...？
Me？ I'm fine, looks like I didn't catch it.
Yeah, that's great. Was it the power of my visit, I wonder？
Yeah, thanks for that. ...How about you after that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Ah, umm... I was fine too.
Thanks to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, my cold is all better.
I'm glad. That kiss back then really did the trick, huh？
Yeah... Wait, does that mean you might've caught it...？
Don't worry. I managed not to catch it from you either.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seems a little different from usual？)
You might be surprised if I tell you this, but...
What do you mean 'what'？... You, of course. Is that bad？
It's not that, but... I'm not surprised. That's just a given.
It is, but... it isn't. Because...
I love you so much... it's not like usual.
Sorry, I sound crazy, don't I...？ I think I'm going a little crazy...
I love you so much, it's driving me crazy...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seems off... Is she mad at me？)
...You already know. I love you, I love you, I looove you!
I don't care! I love you!
Don't you have anything to say？
(Hm？ Is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in a good mood？)
My face is so hot... I feel like I'm gonna explode...
I mean, right now, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you're kind of...
No... I don't wanna hear it. If you say it, I really will explode...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ being this bold... She's even more daring than usual...)
Geez, I said no comments, and I mean it!
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was even more forward than usual...)
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲... What was that just now...？
